description: The year-to-date block (six or nine months, as the latest 10-Q reports it) and, where the record has one, the prior-year year-to-date comparative from the same 10-Q: income statement, cash flow and segment data for the fiscal year so far. Year-to-date cash flow is what a 10-Q actually prints. Actual dollars (not millions), shares split-adjusted, a foreign issuer's figures in US dollars. Pass `record` for an earlier published record.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_year_to_date
title: Year to date and prior year to date
